description: Overload target beyond capacity. Measure error rate, shed-rate, and latency tail under sustained overload. Target must not OOM or deadlock.
loopback_caveat: Results are not equivalent to network-path benchmarks. transport_mode=loopback-h1 is mandatory in all result artifacts.

load_profile.note: Latency tail and error ratio are the primary metrics. RPS is secondary.

thresholds.note: 30% error rate is acceptable during overload phase. Crash or OOM is a hard failure.

community_h1_k6_v1.note: ramping-arrival-rate executor; BASELINE_RATE and OVERLOAD_RATE are configurable env vars. Total run = 180s (baseline 30s + ramp 30s + sustain 60s + recover 30s + confirm 30s). Latency tail and error ratio are the primary claim evidence.

claim_scope_note: Resilience characterization only. No comparative throughput claims.
